title: Writing: What Can We Do for the Environment?
writingModel: The environment is being damaged every day by human activity. But there are things that can be done — by governments, companies, and individuals like us.
First, waste must be reduced. Plastic bags should be replaced by reusable ones. Food packaging needs to be made from recycled materials. These are small changes that can be implemented immediately.

Second, renewable energy should be developed. Solar panels can be installed on buildings. Fossil fuels must be replaced gradually. In Kazakhstan, wind and solar energy is being explored as an alternative.

Third, awareness must be raised. Environmental education should be included in school and university programmes. Events like the WKU Eco Club's tree-planting days help students understand that every action matters.
I believe the environment can be protected if we all take responsibility. As Zhibek says: 'We don't inherit the Earth from our ancestors — we borrow it from our children.'
